space.$description: Steps of Tailwind's shipped spacing scale (0.25rem × n) that a semantic token needs. The rest of the scale is used as shipped until task 2.

width.$description: Steps of Tailwind's shipped border-width scale. Fixed unit: RESPONSIVE.md § Unit policy allowlist.

sm.$description: The shipped radius (0.625rem) × 0.6 — the only radius primitive of the placeholder theme.

breakpoint.$description: Tailwind's shipped md and lg breakpoints. Emitted as literals in a generated @theme block and in breakpoints.ts, because a media query cannot read a custom property.
